file_rules.why: A renamed or missing column breaks every rule after it, for every row: reject the whole file.

rules.why: Nothing to settle or trace without them.
A lower-case or short PNR won't match the booking.
Airline designators are 2 characters; digits are allowed (6E).
A booking class is one upper-case letter; never guess k into K.
Without the hyphen we can't split origin and destination.
Money settles to 2 decimals; a third decimal is bad source data.
A short ticket number can't be matched in settlement.
25/11/2026 is ambiguous between day-first and month-first.
An IATA agency number is 8 digits; otherwise no commission or ADM can be raised.
We only settle airlines we have a contract for.
An unpublished class has no fare rules to price or refund against.
An unknown airport means the route can't be priced or prorated.
An unknown currency can't be converted or settled.
Another airline's ticket prefix would settle money to the wrong carrier.
No real journey flies from an airport to itself.
A ticket can't be issued after the file that reports it.
A zero or negative fare on an issue file is a refund or an error, not a sale.
The sale is real, only reported late: settle it, but make the delay visible.
The first copy is already validated: count the repeat, don't settle it twice.
